scene: Inside the crimson tent, chemical trays steam beneath a glowing amber lamp.
picture: A flat side-view inside a darkroom tent lined on level ground. Left, a wooden table holds a shallow chemical tray under an amber lamp. The curly-haired boy in a denim jacket stands right of center. Center stands a masked chemist holding tongs. Far right shows a heavy curtained exit slit.
shown: a shallow plastic tray bubbling with silver chemical liquid on the left
a masked chemist holding glass tongs standing silently in the centre
a slit curtain draped with thick velvet fabric on the far right
